visualCharacteristics: Full-width rotating promo carousel; each slide is a full-bleed photo/graphic banner linking to a promo, first slide is a live LOTTO 6/49 jackpot draw panel over an image. Prev/next arrows and dot pagination on a beige (#f5ede6) control bar below the slides.
contentPattern: Interactive rotating component with arrows and dot pagination; each slide is an image with optional text/CTA. Photo backgrounds belong to the block, so the section is not colored. Full-bleed promo banner slides with arrows and dot bar below; no existing carousel variant in blocks/
usage: Home page hero promo rotator: a LOTTO 6/49 next-draw jackpot slide (background image + logo, draw date, jackpot paragraphs, CTA) followed by image-only promo banner slides whose image links to the promo.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width rotating promo banners with a control bar (prev, dots, next) below the slides. One row per slide: cell 1 = image (link it for image-only slides), cell 2 = optional text/CTA. Leave cell 2 empty for banner-only slides.

cells: Image (mandatory): slide background/banner image; for image-only slides, link the image to the promo URL
Text (optional): title as heading, description/additional paragraphs, CTA link

usage: Slide 1: cell1 = draw background image; cell2 = game logo image, 'Next Draw: Sat. 24 Oct. 2026', '$5M CLASSIC JACKPOT +', '$28 000 000', 'GOLD BALL JACKPOT', 'OR THE GUARANTEED $1M' as paragraphs, CTA 'Get your ticket' (game-configurator lotto-649 page). Slides 2-5: cell1 = banner image linked to the promo URL; cell2 empty.
blockContent.description: 5 slides: (1) LOTTO 6/49 next-draw jackpot panel (background image, game logo, 'Next Draw: Sat. 24 Oct. 2026', '$5M CLASSIC JACKPOT +', '$28 000 000', 'GOLD BALL JACKPOT OR THE GUARANTEED $1M', CTA 'Get your ticket'); (2-5) linked promo banner images ($20 Bonus, Mega 360, PlayWise player tools, Proline fall multisport)
